title: Hawara labyrinth and the 2008 Mataha expedition GPR scan

tellings.quote: There was an expedition, I think it was 2008 called the Mataha expedition. They GPR scanned it. They found that there's a huge slab, limestone slab, that's actually not the floor, but actually the roof of this underground chamber system.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm talks about Hawara, an ancient site in Egypt said to hold a great labyrinth. He says a 2008 expedition, which he thinks was called the Mataha expedition, scanned the ground with ground-penetrating radar, a tool that bounces radio waves into the earth to map what lies below. According to Drumm, they found a huge limestone slab that is not a floor but the roof of an underground chamber system, which would mean a large hidden structure lies beneath the site.
